parsed.why: Same-sex conduct criminalised with 10-year penalty upheld in 2024; no anti-discrimination or support infrastructure; trans teen assaulted then charged with fraud. No trans-specific statute or enforcement data, but hostile state and society.

Public same-sex affection criminalised; documented police arrests on false accusations plus mistreatment and torture of LGBTQ people; entrenched discrimination and concealment; no protections. Trans-specific data absent, worsening it below dossier 1.

No criminalisation of gender identity or expression and ordinary border treatment, but hate-crime enforcement fails, anti-trans violence documented, strong social hostility, and 2024 education law frames gender identity as threat.

Strong national anti-discrimination and hate-crime law covering gender identity, X markers, self-declared custody placement protocol, marriage and care access. Residual violence, discrimination and divergent prison practice in one state temper but do not dominate.

Decriminalised since 2010 and constitution bans gender-identity discrimination, with cultural third-gender acceptance; but no implementation for markers, conservative social mores, police mistrust, and a documented 2018 trans murder.
